backtest_2025.note: Walk-forward, 2025 weeks 4–18, REC_SLOPE 0.35, active = depth-chart top-N who dressed

pass_gate.rule: passing-yard rungs return to the board when the passing model's Brier beats the books at the main lines over 3 or more graded weeks combined

paper_only.td_rule: season-to-date 50/50 blend beats the no-vig market by 0.001 Brier on anytime TD
paper_only.yds_rule: model P(over) beats the no-vig book on Brier at the main lines over at least 3 graded weeks

rescore_current.rule: EV >= 5% at the median and best book, 2+ books, no weak-spot players, 50/50 model-market blend; closing prices for backfilled weeks, flag-time prices for live weeks; yard edges from the slate's edge list at a 10-yard floor; 1u for every role, no board rules (the board-rules view is record_current_rules)

slips_backtest.note: 2024 + 2025 weeks 4-18, depth-chart regime, n=3000 sim games; single-leg P(stat >= rung) in 5-point buckets (whole points) with the 1.96*sqrt(p(1-p)/n) range; a bucket is in range when |pred - actual| <= range, as in yards_backtest.report(); MAE of the median vs the season-average baseline

record_current_rules.rule: same bets at the same prices; passing-yard rungs removed, Rotational players over 2.5x the no-vig market removed, Bench at 0.25u, parlays separate

bench_gate.rule: Bench returns to 1u only after 100+ bench bets with positive CLV and positive units once the single biggest win is removed

longshot_gate.rule: anytime TD singles priced +1000 or longer, live weeks only (no backfill), every role, graded as logged. If after week 8 grades the group's units are still below its expected units it moves to research-only: logged, graded, not on the Edge Board. Pre-registered 2026-10-12; nothing changes before then
